\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]

\subsection{\texttt{snapshot}}
\label{method:feedback_intelligence_agent.qdrant_store.QdrantVectorStore.snapshot}\index{Methods!snapshot}
Load chunks and vectors into an independent local retrieval snapshot.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
snapshot(self) -> InMemoryVectorStore
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{InMemoryVectorStore}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{QdrantStoreError}
\apifield{Details}Callers must coordinate writers across the entire paginated read. This method does not supply a database transaction or lock external clients. The returned store makes no further Qdrant calls during retrieval.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}qdrant\_\allowbreak{}store.\allowbreak{}py:139}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/6535a020f449db4ed44aa84d8054e7c837c16b97/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/qdrant_store.py#L139}{online})

\subsection{\texttt{upsert\_sources}}
\label{method:feedback_intelligence_agent.qdrant_store.QdrantVectorStore.upsert_sources}\index{Methods!upsert\_sources}
Replace complete tenant-scoped sources, including obsolete trailing chunks.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
upsert_sources(self, chunks: list[DocumentChunk], vectors: npt.NDArray[np.float64]) -> int
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{chunks}] \texttt{list[DocumentChunk]\allowbreak{}}, required.
  \item[\texttt{vectors}] \texttt{npt.\allowbreak{}NDArray[np.\allowbreak{}float64]\allowbreak{}}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{int}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{QdrantStoreError}
\apifield{Details}Supply chunks produced by \texttt{feedback\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}chunks} with canonical source, chunk, tenant, and feedback identities. All input is validated before any remote mutation. New points are upserted with \texttt{wait=True} before obsolete point IDs are deleted, also with \texttt{wait=True}. Other sources are untouched.

This is not a transaction: readers can see intermediate state and a remote failure can leave a partial update. Retrying the identical batch converges. Callers must serialize concurrent writes to the same sources, including writes through other clients. Disjoint sources may be updated independently.

Returns the number of previous chunks belonging to the supplied sources, including overwritten chunk IDs, matching the in-memory store's counts. An empty batch is a no-op, not a request to delete a source.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}qdrant\_\allowbreak{}store.\allowbreak{}py:207}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/6535a020f449db4ed44aa84d8054e7c837c16b97/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/qdrant_store.py#L207}{online})
